answer: Sybil resistance requires binding each agent’s identity to an attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, and a hardware-protected key—not to the measurement alone, which can be shared by many enclaves. Remote verification checks the code measurement and key provenance; duplicating a VM cannot copy the silicon-held secret, so creating another valid identity requires another eligible hardware root, typically additional physical silicon. Names such as yarrow, lantern, and basalt remain labels, not identities.
